newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: National Bank of NZ 6 mth net profit rises 78 pct.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of NZ 6 mth net profit rises 78 pct.

text.p: The Lloyds TSB Group owned National Bank of New Zealand said on Monday it made an operating surplus after tax of NZ$73 million in the six months to June 30 against $41 million for the year ago period.
The pre-tax operating surplus was $110 million against $60 million.
Net interest income was $215 million against $169 million, while other operating revenue was unchanged on $105 million.
Provisions rose to $8 million from $4 million.
Operating expenses were $202 million, down from $210 million, and tax was up at $37 million compared with $19 million.
A spokeswoman said the result improved due to increased margins, new products and cost containments.
